scope: 2.2.5. Statistical correlation analysis for inputs determination

matched: Spearman's rank correlation used to assess statistical relationships between inputs and outputs based on qualitative analysis
Nonparametric method quantifies monotonic associations without normal distribution assumption
Suitable for nonlinear yet monotonic classification contexts (Hastie et al., 2009)
Statistical significance determined via p-values under null hypothesis of no monotonic relationship
p-value < 0.05 rejects null hypothesis and confirms significant correlation
spearmanr function in SciPy (Python) computes coefficients and p-values for all variable pairs
